label: MTN Ads (MTN Advertising)
terms_note: Register on developers.mtn.com, create an app → OAuth 2.0 client credentials; product availability per operating company (Group portal moving to appx.developers.mtn.com). Free tier / commercial terms per product.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (MTN Developer Portal app: client_id / client_secret)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (telco advertising data APIs, not campaign management) Confidence: **high** — official developer portal read.
auth: 1. Register an account on developers.mtn.com and create an App.
2. OAuth 2.0 client credentials (`grant_type=client_credentials`, client_id, client_secret) → bearer.
3. Subscribe the App to 'MTN Advertising API V1' / 'Advertising V2' (country availability: UG, Eswatini, group).

endpoints.purpose: not offered (MTN Ads inventory is sales-led)

reference.limits: - Per-product quotas and commercial terms on the portal; portal migration notice for Group users.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: MTN's Advertising category (https://developers.mtn.com/categories/advertising: 'Reach customers with APIs engineered for mobile advertising') offers ad-serving products whose Advertising V2 swagger exposes POST /v1/customers/{customerId} 'Fetch Adverts' to deliver ads to a subscriber; there are no advertiser account, campaign, budget or report endpoints to map.
